attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a router between two isolated segments: eth1 (172.20.1.1/24, toward node2) and eth2 (172.20.2.1/24, toward node3), with IPv4 forwarding enabled globally and per-interface. Configured node2's enp8s0 as 172.20.1.2/24 and node3's enp8s0 as 172.20.2.2/24 via NetworkManager static profiles, each with a static route to the other's segment via node1. Verified node2<->node3 reachability through node1. Persisted node1's config via /etc/network/interfaces.d/60-antrieb-segments (auto-applied by SONiC's networking service, sourced from the stock interfaces template) and /etc/sysctl.d/99-antrieb.conf (applied at boot by systemd-sysctl). Restarted node1 with a native `reboot`, confirmed a changed boot_id after it came back (SONiC boot took ~4 minutes), confirmed eth1/eth2 addresses and forwarding sysctls returned automatically without any post-boot intervention, and re-verified node2<->node3 ping succeeded with 0% loss in both directions. node2 and node3 were not restarted (task scoped the restart to node1 only; they were never disrupted so no restart evidence applies to them).
